column3: Re-derives proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YD2i.v, YD2j.v and YD1k.v: steps 1-4b and the pinned-original stamp of the start-up generator run (hsform.py hs, gen_ad2.py, gen_ad1k.py, check4.py, zifyhook.py, pins.py stamp) from the collector pass-2 extract (collector/dumps/pass2.dump.00 and .01, joined), twin/, the released donor templates proofs/cgif/cgif_file_fuzzer/lib/{YB01,YD2i,YD2j,YD1k,YF0m}.v, the unit files proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/{YB12,YB1h,YF0m,YImgTop}.v and the two image B pins. Then cmp: YD2j.v and YD1k.v byte-equal to the shipped files. YD2i.v is byte-equal to the generator's recorded output (YD2i.v at commit 8d49db691712); the shipped YD2i.v adds a hand edit with no numeral (one Modified line, a comment and Hypothesis H1_8, and H1_8 as the sixth mkW argument of W1), and run.sh pins that diff by its sha256. The intermediate YB01.v equals the shipped proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB01.v below its header comments, its per-hole record equals collector/YB01.v.json, and the four records equal records/. With TWIN_B (and TWIN_B2) it also makes twin/ again and compares it. The generator's step-5 address-provenance call is left out: the gates of record re-run that check.

Forms the 50 hand-off states (the intermediate YB01.v and YB01.v.json) from the collector pass-2 printed results, with the pin, KImg, malloc_context_size, arrival-at-main and descriptor-array gates. Copy of the start-up generator hsform.py sha256 4be76b651fc5 with one docstring line reworded; no code changed. It reads the pass-2 extract in place of the build log with the same parse (readlog, dump_list, holes_of: the same HSDUMPHOLES / HSDUMP markers); run.sh omits --pass because the extract holds only the one Pass2.v compile, and the YB01.v it writes is byte-equal to the one the unchanged tool writes from the log with --pass Pass2.

Module hsform.py imports: the image memory reader and the descriptor-array reader (Mem, state_bytes, descriptors), cut verbatim from the start-up generator af0m.py sha256 2ac2dbe25a9a (lines 34-44, 47-84, 87-94). Below its docstring it is the same code as collector/tools/af0m.py.

Generates proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YD2i.v and YD2j.v (the main-entry state and the region table) from the hand-off states, the unit atable / TSEGS / owned-static files, the image and the twin symbol extract, on the donor templates; writes records/B.report and records/B.gate.md. Copy of the start-up generator gen_ad2.py sha256 e7605673f1ef with two comment lines reworded; no code changed (its symbol reader load_syms already reads an nm listing such as twin/disco_ub.symtab).

Generates proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YD1k.v (the donor text with its image literals restated from the generated YD2j.v, the owned-static file, the image and the twin's stdio FILE symbols); writes records/YD1k.sites.md. Copy of the start-up generator gen_ad1k.py sha256 c188421f4cf5 in which all_symbols reads the twin symbol extract in place of the twin's .symtab (same entries, same order, same filter), and the docstring, the --twin help and four role texts of the sites table no longer name another work stream.

Map check 4 on the generated YD2j.v / YD1k.v pair with cgif's released pair as the control (regions, chunks, TSEGS, PT_LOAD bounds, the YD1k literals); writes records/check4.md and exits 1 on any failure. Copy of the start-up generator check4.py sha256 620ff8f53907 with one docstring line reworded; no code changed.

Adds the Zify pre-hook after a Require of YImgTop (step 4b); YD2i.v, YD2j.v and YD1k.v do not Require YImgTop, so it leaves them unchanged. Copy of the start-up generator zifyhook.py sha256 db7fa393c85e with three docstring lines reworded; no code changed.

The pinned-original gate and stamp: refuses an image whose sha256 is not a row of the index OSSV_BINARIES_TSV names, and writes the "(* Read from: ... *)" line of YB01.v, YD2i.v, YD2j.v and YD1k.v. Copy of the start-up generator pins.py sha256 9065ddfc51f1 in which the index is only OSSV_BINARIES_TSV or --index (the host default is removed), and the twin sha256 is taken from the first header line of the twin symbol extract when --twin is not an ELF; docstring reworded.

Writes the two text extracts of the unstripped twin of image B that the generators read in place of the twin (rule 4): the names file (first .symtab entry of each name, sorted by address) and the symbol extract (every named .symtab entry except the $ mapping symbols, in .symtab order). It refuses unless PT_LOAD 2..4 of twin and pin are byte-equal; with --same it also checks a second twin of the same pin. New version of the host tool mknm.py sha256 297ecfe6da07 (same names rule) with the header, the check and the second output added.

Names file of the unstripped twin of image B (2895 names), the hsform.py --names input for the malloc_context_size and arrival-at-main gates. Made by twin/mknm.py from the twin of sha256 65947ff283f5 that the run of record read; the header names it, the pin cee6f04ad3d4 and the PT_LOAD 2..4 check. The twin ead714913acd of the release has the same .symtab (7303 entries) and the same PT_LOAD 2..4 (byte-equal to the pin) and differs only in .note.gnu.build-id and the .debug_* sections, so either twin gives the same body; the header says so. The body is byte-equal to the names file the run of record read.

Symbol extract of the same twin (2936 entries; same header as twin/disco_ub.nm): the --twin input of hsform.py, gen_ad2.py, gen_ad1k.py and pins.py stamp. gen_ad2.py and gen_ad1k.py read their twin symbols from it; pins.py takes the twin sha256 of the stamp line (65947ff283f5, as in the shipped files) from its first header line.

The gen_ad2.py region-table gate of the generated YD2j.v (81 regions: bounds, order, disjointness, chunks inside regions, PT_LOAD extents, gaps only where the donor has them), with the donor regions beside it. run.sh regenerates it byte for byte; same bytes as the record of the run of record.

The gen_ad2.py report of the run: the computed data items (TFIB_MAIN, the TID and canary variables, image and window bounds, the main-entry registers, the 81 regions), PRECHECK ok, GATE ok and 17 twin-symbol checks ok. run.sh regenerates it byte for byte; it differs from the record of the run of record only in the file paths it names.

The gen_ad1k.py site table: each of the 22 replaced literals of proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YD1k.v, donor line, output line, old and new value, role and source, and the 60 CH alternatives. run.sh regenerates it byte for byte; it differs from the record of the run of record only in four role texts that named another work stream.

Map check 4 on the generated YD2j.v / YD1k.v with cgif's released pair as the control: VERDICT pass (81 regions). run.sh regenerates it byte for byte; it differs from the record of the run of record only in the file paths it names and in the command echo and exit lines of the run wrapper.
